channel.title: Cork Safety Alerts - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Cork Safety Alerts (corksafetyalerts.com)

item.title: Road Hazard N25 Ballybraher
item.description: Reports of a large metal sign on the road on the N25 near Ballybraher, just east of Castlemartyr, approaching Midleton. It is causing cars to swerve. Take care on approach.

item.title: Multi-vehicle Collision on N40 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a multi-vehicle collision, westbound, on the N40 South Ring Road at N40(W) Off-Slip,Junction 6,N40W. Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 17 February at 18:19.

item.title: Learner Driver Caught Doing 132km/h in 80km/h Zone in Cork
item.description: A learner driver was caught doing 132km/h in an 80km/h zone in Cork this weekend. The vehicle was seized and fixed charge notices issued.

item.title: Collision on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a collision, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road between Junction 5 (Togher) and Junction 4 (Sarsfield Road). Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision on N72 Ballyvorisheen
item.description: Reports of a collision on the N72 near the junction with N73/Ballyvorisheen junction (just ouside Mallow.) Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Gardaí Urge Caution on Cork Roads as Yellow Weather Warning Takes Effect
item.description: Gardaí are urging all Cork drivers to slow down and take extra care as a Status Yellow rain warning brings flooding risk and poor visibility tonight into Wednesday.

item.title: Road Closure on N40 Eastbound
item.description: Reports of a road closure due to a collision at N40(E) On-Slip,J3, eastbound, on the N40 South Ring Road at N40(E) On-Slip,Junction 3. Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 17 February at 21:41.

item.title: Collision on N25 Westbound
item.description: Reports of a collision, westbound, on the N25 Cork to Waterford Road between Junction 3 (Cobh Cross) and Junction 2 (Little Island). Take care on approach.

item.title: Collision at Gortroche
item.description: Reports of a collision at Gortroche, near Cools (North Cork.) Emergency services are en route. Take care on approach.

item.title: Hazard on N25 Westbound
item.description: Reports of hazard, westbound, on the N25 between Junction 3 Cobh and Junction 2 Little Island (Cork). Take care on approach.Source: TII Traffic Alerts, 18 February at 07:14.
